record.question: With regard to an AND gate, which statement is true?
options: An AND gate has two inputs and one output.
An AND gate has two or more inputs and two outputs.
If one input to a 2-input AND gate is HIGH, the output reflects the other input.
A 2-input AND gate has eight input possibilities.
record.explanation: A 2-input AND gate has exactly two inputs and one output. It produces a HIGH output only when all inputs are HIGH.
